execution_notes: An initial audit stopped before corpus comparisons because it compared the manifest file hash with the original ledger compact-JSON hash. The corrected run preserves both checks and recovers every ledger row. Initial logs and tools remain archived.
Only the corrected, qualified replay supplies these overlap results. A preceding formatting check failure and its older-binary preflight attempt are not qualification evidence.
limitations: Current publisher bytes plus 2019 publication metadata support only weak historical-proxy labels, not a documented human-only workflow.

Manual review covers complete rendering, credited authors and notices; it does not establish scientific or grammatical correctness.
